name: Energy-Demand-Prediction
description: A machine learning project that forecasts electricity demand using time-series energy market data. It applies feature engineering techniques such as lag features, rolling statistics, and time-based variables, and uses an XGBoost regression model to predict short-term demand for infrastructure planning and analysis.
